subject.title: Add daily cost and plan usage history for OpenCode Go

question: Should OpenCode Go Auto mode enrich a successful web fetch with device-local SQLite daily history, while explicit Web mode must never read that local history?
rationale: This is a user-visible source-selection and local-data policy choice; tests can verify mechanics but cannot establish the intended product contract.

options.title: Keep additive Auto enrichment
options.body: Accept local daily-history enrichment in Auto mode, retain the strict Web-only opt-out, and require proof for both modes before merge.

options.title: Keep web results web-only
options.body: Limit local history to the local fallback path so a successful web fetch never causes a local database read.

options.title: Pause for a provider-source policy
options.body: Defer the feature until the repository defines a consistent provider-source policy for mixed web and local data.

recommendation.title: Keep additive Auto enrichment
recommendation.body: Accept local daily-history enrichment in Auto mode, retain the strict Web-only opt-out, and require proof for both modes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely repository owner and the best available routing candidate for deciding the user-facing data-source contract.
